summary_semantics: Legacy per-rule status 'covered' means name/threshold mapping only. Rows whose stored klayout_values differ from current ics55_rules.json are stale; no row gets semantic-equivalence credit from this static crosswalk. The vendor ${metal_layer} loop is expanded manually for the active M2-M5 stack; M6-M8 are inactive in this profile. The vendor .ant deck is expanded for the frozen profile M=6, T=1, TM_NAME=T4M2, TV_NAME=T4V2, RDL_thickness=1.595 (28 unique rules); loop IDs are stored in expanded form.
